title: Remember Him While You’re Little
traveler_why: Tonight is a story about starting the adventure of knowing Heavenly Father now rather than later, and Scout the Seeker is the Traveler who answers “you’re too little” by going ahead and beginning anyway.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves to start the adventure of knowing Heavenly Father early. In Scout’s world today: Scout’s big cousin said, “You’re too little to say prayers by yourself.” But Scout said, “No I’m not — I can start now!” and folded little arms and prayed a sweet, simple prayer all alone. Just like the wise teacher said to remember Heavenly Father while young, Scout discovered you’re never too little to know Him.
